## [[{{< iconify game-icons:lightning-arc >}}]{.biggeR}[Quarto]{.frank}[{{< iconify game-icons:lightning-arc >}}]{.biggeR} {{< iconify ic:baseline-electric-bolt >}}[Live!!]{.frank .Bigger}{{< iconify game-icons:lightning-trio >}}](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/){#sec-quartolive}


::: {.panel-tabset}

### General Use

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="60%"}

````{text}
```{webr}
for (x in 1:5) {
  print(10 + x)
}
```
````

1. `webr` code block
2.  {{< iconify devicon:r >}} (or {{< iconify devicon:python-wordmark >}}) commands
3. run script & view output {{< iconify at-icons:arrow-up-right >}}

:::

::: {.column width="40%"}

```{webr}
#| eval: true
for (x in 1:5) {
  print(10 + x)
}
```

:::

:::

### Options {{< iconify arcticons:settings >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="35%"}

You can control the user experience via YAML or [chunk--level specifications](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/getting_started/editor.html):
::: 

::: {.column width="32%"}

```{r}
---
format: live-html         #<1>
webr:
  packages:
    - dplyr               #<2>
    - palmerpenguins
    - ggplot2             #<2>
---
```
1. `live-` prefix for document type (must support interactive content)
2. any packages you'd like to be available on the client--side


::: 

::: {.column width="33%"}

````{r}
```{webr}
#| edit: false        
#| autorun: true
#| startover: false
#| timelimit: 3       
df <- c(1, 2, 3)
df[1]
```
````

::: 

:::

### Exercises {{< iconify fa:graduation-cap >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="33%"}

[specification](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/exercises/exercises.html):

[Fill in the blank to achieve an answer of "10":]{.tiny .links .underline}

````{r}
```{webr}              #<1>
#| exercise: ex_1      #<2>

1 + 2 + 3 + ______     #<3>
```
````
1. code cell 'type' is `webr` 
2. unique label (here, "ex_1") links different code chunks as well as hints, etc
3. "blanks" identified by 6 or more underscores

::: 

::: {.column width="35%"}

[grading](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/exercises/exercises.html):

````{r}
```{webr}
#| exercise: ex_1    #<1>
#| check: true          

if (identical(.result, 10)) {                 #<2>
  list(correct = TRUE, message = "Nice work!")
} else {
  list(correct = FALSE, message = "You suck!!")
}
```
````
1. needs to match corresponding exercise label
2. `identical(.result)` allows for multiple solutions (will only attend to output)

::: 

::: {.column width="32%"}

[hints & solutions](https://r-wasm.github.io/quarto-live/exercises/exercises.html#adding-hints-and-solutions):

```{r}
::: {.hint exercise="ex_1"}    #<1>
This is your hint
:::                            #<1>

::: {.solution exercise="ex_1"}
Do it this way!!!
:::
```
1. note these are specified within "floating" Quarto fences, not within code chunks

::: 

:::

:::
